art_direction: high-detail glossy anime/chibi Japanese fantasy; cinematic moonlit temples; ornate ninja armor; consistent character proportions and rendering
legendary_rule: Legendary characters must carry the rainbow/prismatic treatment on clothing, armor, mask, sash and/or weapons. Do not use a rainbow background as the defining Legendary trait.
epic_rule: Epic uses the same high-detail anime/chibi rendering as the approved Epic #031 direction, with strong elemental or magical FX but no mandatory rainbow outfit.
